title: Extend data model for parent/child task hierarchy
userStory: As a developer, I want tasks to have sub-tasks so that large features can be broken into independently executable stories.
acceptanceCriteria: Task schema includes: parentId (nullable), childIds[], taskType (feature|story|simple)
Feature-level tasks contain planning context and spawn child stories
Story-level tasks are executable units with acceptance criteria
Child tasks inherit workspaceId, branch config from parent
Index tracks hierarchy for efficient querying
Simple tasks have no children and execute directly
